title: Statements
intro: Upload your credit card statement as a PDF. I read the file on this computer; the card number, name and address are removed before anything is saved.
notPdf: You can only upload a PDF file.
reconOkBody: The balance on the statement and the sum of the lines I read are the same: <m>{{amount}}</m>.
reconMismatchBody: The statement says <m>{{expected}}</m>; the lines I read add up to <m>{{computed}}</m>. The difference is <c>{{difference}}</c>.
reconMismatchWhy: I may have missed a line, or the statement shows an item separately.
reconMismatchNext: My numbers use the lines I read. Check them against your bank’s transaction list before you pay.
errUnknown: I don’t recognise the layout of this PDF. For now I can only read statements from supported banks.
errTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errNetwork: I can’t reach the local server.
